address: No. 65, Nanjing Olympic Sports Center, 222 Jiangdong Middle Road, Jianye, Nanjing, China Mainland
bio: This spacious looker comes complete with a garden and majestic rooms that meld Baroque-style furniture and art with Chinese architectural motifs. The menu lists mainly traditional Anhui dishes, with ingredients shipped directly from the province. The signature fermented mandarin fish, braised in either an aromatic brown sauce or spicy chilli sauce, is perfect with a bowl of steamed rice. Certain soups and the roast duck need to be pre-ordered....
